title: Motion Sciences anti-gravity effort debunked

tellings.quote: Yeah, in 2010 Dr. Puthoff and Dr. Green were part of the science advisory board for an effort called Motion Sciences

plain: In 2010 a project called Motion Sciences tried to build an anti-gravity device in a hangar at the Provo airport in Utah, and it was shown not to work. The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange happenings, tells it as someone who was involved, saying the scientists Hal Puthoff and Kit Green sat on its science advisory board, so even serious names backed an effort that came to nothing.
